title: FEDformer: Frequency-domain decomposition improves forecasting on strongly periodic signals in ETTh1, ETTh2, ETTm2
abstract: We study long-horizon multivariate forecasting using FEDformer, a frequency-enhanced decomposition transformer. On ETTh1, ETTh2, ETTm2, at horizon 336, Frequency-domain decomposition improves forecasting on strongly periodic signals in ETTh1, ETTh2, ETTm2. FEDformer reduces MSE by 10% over time-domain baselines on ETTh1. We discuss two limitations: Missing-value handling is delegated to preprocessing and not stress-tested. Comparison omits linear baselines that recent work has shown to be competitive. Future work should address reducing memory usage at input length ≥ 2048 without accuracy loss. and pretraining on a mixture of datasets to test transfer. [SEED-FIXTURE — not a real publication].
